pages.text:
When you embark on a journey to consider what matters most to you, sometimes you find
it right where you are. You find it by opening your mind to new philosophies and your eyes
to new styles. Thereby discovering what truly reflects your personality. Open yourself up
to Lincoln MKZ. Take in the elegant simplicity of its stunning exterior, accentuated by
distinctive curves and punctuated by dramatic accents. Experience the premium amenities
of its impeccably crafted interior. The 2016 Lincoln MKZ is yours to discover.
2016
LINCOLN MKZ + HYBRID
Lincoln.com
